## Summary

Senior Full Stack AI Engineer with 5+ years building AI-driven SaaS products, automation pipelines,
voice agents, and serverless cloud systems. End-to-end ownership across frontend (React, Next.js),
backend (NestJS, Node.js), DevOps (AWS Lambda, SST, Docker, GitHub Actions), and AI integrations
(OpenAI, Claude, LangChain, RAG, OCR, voice agents). Delivered production systems for US and European
clients — dynamic LLM architectures, AI voice agents, CRM automations, and serverless cloud deployments.
Comfortable working directly with founders and non-technical stakeholders.

## Detailed Work Experience

### Full Stack AI Developer @ Pinecrest Consulting — Texas, United States
**Sept. 2025 – May 2026**
Stack: NestJS · Next.js · React 19 · AWS Lambda · SST · CloudFront · GitHub Actions · OpenAI · Claude API · OCR · GA4 · Cursor · Claude Code

Delivered three production serverless products:
- **CT (Commission Tracker):** commission analyzer for 50+ companies using a two-step dynamic prompt architecture (company identification → company-specific extraction), OCR pipeline on PDF reports, queue-based serverless processing, hallucination-reduction validation.
- **UMI (Unified Meeting Intelligence):** multi-platform meeting integration (Google Meet, Zoom, Teams) with AI transcription via OpenAI Whisper, smart summaries, follow-up generation, RAG chat interface, mem0 persistent memory, and third-party file uploads.
- **BMC (Benefit Match Center):** React 19 SPA on S3 + CloudFront with streaming AI chat, Lambda form handlers, and full SEO stack (JSON-LD structured data, GA4, Open Graph, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, sitemap.xml, robots.txt with AI crawler rules).
Also automated social media scheduling via Metricool API.

### AI/Web Bot Developer @ D2V — Germany
**Aug. 2025 – Oct. 2025**
Stack: RAG · Mistral · Notion API · Oura Ring API · Bolt · Claude Code
RAG Voice Chat, Notion–Mistral automations, Oura Ring API integrations, and custom AI tooling under strict NDA.

### Full Stack AI / DevOps Developer @ Relatividad IA — Quito, Ecuador
**Dec. 2024 – Aug. 2025**
Stack: React · Next.js · N8N · AWS ECS · Evolution API · Twilio · Retell AI · GHL · ElevenLabs · CRM · Cursor

Built a Logistic Tracker SaaS and WhatsApp CRM platform with N8N orchestration, Evolution API, and AWS ECS deployment. Designed AI voice call agents (Twilio + Retell-style flows + ElevenLabs TTS) with speech-to-text pipelines, multi-turn prompt flows for lead qualification, and GoHighLevel CRM integrations — automating lead creation, follow-ups, and support routing from inbound calls and chats.
